sub_limits_waiting_notes: 24 months waiting for 20 standard diseases/procedures; 36 months waiting for 2 diseases/procedures. PED also 36 months. Moratorium period 60 months.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Hospitalization beyond 24 hrs covered up to Sum Insured (with room/ICU sub-limits)
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Proportionate clause applies if room rent exceeds limits.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day-care procedures (less than 24 hours of hospitalization)

ayush_coverage.limit_text: AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) inpatient treatment up to Sum Insured

room_rent_capping: Up to 2% of SI per day, subject to max of INR 5,000 per day; proportionate clause applies if exceeded.
icu_capping: Up to 5% of SI per day, subject to max of INR 10,000 per day.
copayment_trigger_notes: 5% co-pay on all claims for age <= 75 years; 15% co-pay for age > 75 years.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Up to 25% of SI or Rs. 40,000 per eye, whichever is lower

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, rehabilitation and respite care (Excl 05)
Treatment for Alcoholism, drug or substance abuse (Excl 12)
Treatments in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas (Excl 13)
Nuclear, chemical or biological attack or weapons
Treatment taken outside the geographical limits of India
notable_exclusions_summary: Standard IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani exclusions: no maternity, no domiciliary, no OPD, no overseas treatment, no infertility/sterility. PED waiting is 36 months. Co-pay 5% (up to 75yrs) or 15% (above 75yrs).
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network providers/PPN with pre-authorization within 1 hour. Reimbursement claims within 30 days of discharge; post-hosp claims within 15 days of treatment completion. Claim settlement within 15 days of last document; 45 days if investigation needed. Helpline 1800 345 0330.
